payload.headline: End-to-End AI & Data Science Expert | AI/ML Engineering, Data Platforms, MLOps & Delivery Leadership
payload.short_bio: End-to-end AI and data science expert with 9+ years in technology, including 7+ years delivering production AI, machine-learning, analytics, and data-platform solutions.
payload.long_bio:
I work across the full path from business problem framing to data engineering, modeling, generative and agentic AI, deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous optimization.

My professional interests center on applied AI, product strategy, open-source technologies, and data-driven decision-making. I care about systems that are useful in practice, legible to the people operating them, and accountable to the outcomes they are meant to create.

Outside work, my interests include travel, history, chess, walking, film, gaming, and exploration.

payload.title: Towards a Direct Mental Based Decision Making: Electroencephalography (EEG) Case Study
payload.excerpt: An IEEE ICICS 2020 paper and reproducible EEG/EMG brain-computer interface prototype for real-time decision mapping.
payload.body_markdown:
# Towards a Direct Mental Based Decision Making

**Conference:** 2020 11th International Conference on Information and Communication Systems (ICICS)  
**Published:** April 2020  
**DOI:** [10.1109/ICICS49469.2020.239502](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICICS49469.2020.239502)

Yazeed Hasan co-authored this paper after research and implementation completed from January through April 2019.

The work designed and implemented an AI-enabled brain-computer-interface Tetris prototype controlled through EEG and EMG signals. It covered signal capture, numerical feature extraction, model inference, real-time decision mapping, and integration of model outputs with game-control APIs.

The reproducible implementation was released through a GitHub code repository; the repository URL can be added here after it is reviewed and supplied.
